# alorakanebooks.com

The author site for Alora C. Kane. Static HTML, hosted free on GitHub Pages.

**Do not hand-edit the HTML files.** Every page is generated by `build.py` from one block
of data per story. To put a product live, set its `url` and `cover` in `build.py` and
re-run `python3 build.py`. All four pages, the sitemap, robots.txt and the 404 page
update together.

Set `PUBLISHED = True` in `build.py` and rebuild on the day the site goes live at
alorakanebooks.com. Until then every page carries a noindex tag and robots.txt blocks
crawlers, so the github.io preview never lands in Google.

The full notes, palette and to-do list live in Dropbox at
`_Business / Alora C. Kane / WEBSITE - alorakanebooks.com - build notes`.
